note: Attacker-controlled fuzz input bytes are passed into the config parser as the raw config file content.
The input bytes are copied into a heap buffer that is not guaranteed to be NUL-terminated beyond the copied size.
Each line read from the config buffer is tokenized by the lexer, passing the unterminated buffer to lex_next.
When the lexer encounters a double-quote character, it dispatches to lex_multiline_string to parse a multiline string token.

The loop advances the pointer past characters looking for the closing quote; if the input ends without a closing quote, the loop reads one byte past the end of the unterminated buffer, causing a Global-buffer-overflow READ 1.
The out-of-bounds read value is used to decide the token type, completing the memory-safety violation triggered by a config file containing an unterminated double-quoted string.
